title: runstate v0.5 supervisor convention
description: Pins the supervisor.* topics, the external-report plane (log format 0.4.0; docs/specs/commits-and-lineage.md section 3), renamed from launcher.*: launched (spawn-intent + liveness handle) and terminated (the manner of a launch's process death) name a LAUNCH, and REQUIRE the envelope request_id, the launch's correlation id, as launcher-v0.4 did; died (the death report) names a CLAIM by claim_seq and its request_id is null (launcher-v0.4's prefix-wide request_id rule is split per record). launched and terminated bodies are unchanged from launcher-v0.4. Applied on top of the envelope schema. Prose-only constraints: died.claim_seq names a lifecycle.started of this run; evidence is a string no fold parses; evidence-without-a-cause reports (lost) are written only while the claim is held, and a reap's signal, nonzero exit code or raised exception map to killed or errored (spec section 3, 'Who writes a death report').

request_id.description: The launch's correlation id. Never null on launched or terminated.

Launched.description: Spawn-intent plus the worker's liveness handle. Unchanged from launcher-v0.4.

Terminated.description: The manner of a launch's process death (present-nullable + reason-coupled): exited carries a non-null exit_code (signal null); killed a non-null signal (exit_code null). Unchanged from launcher-v0.4.

Died.description: The death report: a third party's account of how a claim ended. claim_seq names the claim. outcome is preempted, errored, killed or lost (lost: its writer saw the claim end without an exit and nothing of how); a death is never a completion. evidence is a non-empty string no fold parses, e.g. slurm:TIMEOUT. t is the reporter's clock when it saw the death.
